newsitem.title: USA: A&P sells $300 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: A&P sells $300 mln in notes.

text.p: The following issue from Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co (A&P) was priced on Tuesday in the 144a private placement market, according to co-lead manager Chase Securities Inc.
Morgan Stanley & Co Inc was also co-lead manager.
Headquartered in New Jersey, A&P operates 973 supermarkets in the eastern United States and Canada and franchises an additional 49 supermarkets in Canada.
